segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: So what brings you in today?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: I've been getting short of breath at night.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: How long has that been going on?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: About three weeks now, maybe a little longer.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Does it happen when you're lying flat, or also sitting up?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Mostly when I'm lying flat, especially after I've eaten.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Have you noticed any swelling in your legs or ankles?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Yeah, actually, my ankles have been a bit puffy.
